name: search_kpi
description: Find Kolada KPI (indicator) ids by title substring (Swedish). Searches ~5,000 indicators covering economy, schools, health, demographics, and personnel. Returns id, title, description, operating_area, and is_divided_by_gender. Use the returned id with get_data.

title.description: Substring of the indicator title (Swedish), e.g. "arbetslös" or "betyg".

name: list_municipalities
description: Find Sweden municipality/region ids by name substring. Returns id, title, and type ("K" = municipality of 290, "L" = region/landsting of 21). Use the returned id with get_data. Omit title to list all.

title.description: Substring of the municipality/region name, e.g. "Stockholm" or "Göteborg".

name: get_data
description: Fetch numeric KPI values from Kolada for a specific indicator (kpiId), Swedish municipality or region (municipalityId), and year. Returns value rows broken down by gender: T=total, K=women (kvinnor), M=men (män); non-gendered KPIs return only T.municipalityId from list_municipalities. Returns values per gender ("T" total, "K" women, "M" men); non-gendered KPIs report only "T".

name: list_org_units
description: Kolada, the Swedish municipal and regional KPI database run by RKA — list the organizational units it tracks (schools, preschools, eldercare facilities) within one of Sweden's 290 municipalities or 21 regions. Returns id, title, municipality. OU ids can be used for unit-level data drilldowns. Filter by title substring and/or municipality id.

title.description: Substring of the unit name (Swedish), e.g. "skola" or "förskola".

municipalityId.description: Restrict to a municipality/region id, e.g. "0180".
